problem_text:
This pie chart shows how an average American household uses water.

Which of the following can not be found from this pie chart? ![A pie chart showing multiple sections: Toilet 26.7%, Leaks 13.7%, Other 5.3%, Clothes Washer 21.7%, Faucet 15.7%, Shower 16.8% ]()

A. The fraction of the different uses of water
B. The mean amount of water used

correct_answer: B. The mean amount of water used
malrule_answer: A. The fraction of the different uses of water
feedback_text: Remember that a percentage is simply a fraction out of 100, so each percentage shown can be written as a fraction (e.g., 26.7% = 26.7/100). Which of the following is the best estimate for the gradient of the curve when \( t=6 \) ![The image is of a velocity-time graph. There is a straight line, a tangent, drawn so that it is touching the curve at t=6. The tangent goes through (2, 31), (6, 47) and (8,55). ]()

A. \( 0.1875 \)
B. \( 46 \)
C. \( 7.66 \ldots \)

feedback_text: That's not the right answer. Can you try again?

Oh, I see where I went wrong now! I was confusing the velocity value at \( t = 6 \) (which is 47 m/s) with the gradient of the curve. But the gradient of the curve at a point is actually the slope of the tangent line there, which represents acceleration. 

Looking at the tangent line passing through (2, 31) and (6, 47), the change in velocity is \( 47 - 31 = 16 \) m/s, and the change in time is \( 6 - 2 = 4 \) seconds.
